- What we covered:
  - High-level platform overview and deployed architecture for the integration
  - Security posture items: SOC 2 status, data residency, and incident response practices
  - Breach notification expectations and sample timelines (GDPR/HIPAA considerations)

- Action items we agreed on:
  1) FintechCorp to confirm any regulatory timelines or internal SLA for breach notification (e.g., 72 hours GDPR; HIPAA specifics).
  2) Redwood to provide SOC 2 summary and relevant evidence for incident response & BCP/DR (initial excerpts attached).
  3) Fintech to initiate the vendor security questionnaire — we can pre-fill sections if that speeds things up.

Marissa is on the thread for procurement/regulatory handoff; Neha from our security team will follow up with technical IR details.

Please reply with the person on your side who owns breach notification so we can loop them into the next exchange.

Thanks —

Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Alex Huang <alex.huang@fintechcorp.com>

Date: 2026-10-15T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FintechCorp security discovery: incident response & breach notification timelines

Jordan — thanks for the recap and the call earlier. Quick answers from our side:

- Breach notification: Our legal/regulatory requirement is to notify regulators within 72 hours of becoming aware for GDPR-impacting incidents. For HIPAA-related events the response can be more nuanced (we have a 60-day reporting obligation to affected parties in many cases). We'll confirm exact wording but 72 hours is the requirement we operate to for GDPR scope.

- SOC 2: We have a completed SOC 2 Type II report for 2024; we recently started a Type II renewal for 2025 (in progress). We can share our SOC 2 summary and the auditor letter — attaching the SOC2_summary_2025.pdf (summary) and our completed SOC2_2024_report for your records.

- Vendor security questionnaire: attaching our standard security questionnaire (Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_FintechCorp.xlsx). If you can pre-fill the technical sections (IR/BCP/DR) it will speed procurement.

Owner for breach notification: Priya Menon (cc'd) is the lead on incident response and legal coordination — please loop her in for follow-ups.

Thanks,
Alex Huang
Head of IT Security | FintechCorp
Attachment: SOC2_summary_2025.pdf; Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_FintechCorp.xlsx

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alex Huang <alex.huang@fintechcorp.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-10-15T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FintechCorp security discovery: incident response & breach notification timelines

Alex / Priya / team —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. A few notes from Redwood security/infra (technical responses below) and the artifacts we're attaching: IncidentResponse_Playbook_excerpt.pdf (IR playbook excerpt) and SOC2_summary_2025.pdf (Redwood SOC summary excerpt).

1) Incident response ownership & timelines\   - Redwood will escalate any confirmed data breach to customer contacts and account teams within 24 hours of confirmation internally; we target an investigatory update within 48 hours and a formal notification to affected customers within 72 hours when legally required (we follow customer contractual obligations closely).

2) Notification channels and contacts\   - Please confirm the primary contact for security incidents (Priya noted as owner). We'll also need a secondary contact and a billing/contract contact for legal notifications.

3) Evidence and BCP/DR artifacts\   - We're happy to provide: IR playbook excerpts, post-incident report templates, BCP/DR runbook snippets, and relevant SOC2 control mappings. Attached is a short excerpt of our IR playbook. For full evidence requests (logs, runbook snapshots, change histories) we'll follow the process in your questionnaire and can supply redacted artifacts under an executed NDA or the existing contract terms.

4) Questionnaire assistance\   - We can pre-fill the technical sections of the questionnaire (IR, access controls, logging, backup/restore) and return a draft by EOD tomorrow. Let us know which format you prefer (pre-filled spreadsheet vs. a Google Sheet link).

Next steps we propose:
- Fintech confirms Priya + secondary contact and any special regulatory language for GDPR/HIPAA.
- Redwood will pre-fill the vendor questionnaire (technical answers) and return with attachments (SOC2 excerpts, IR playbook) and a pointer to the evidence request process.

Tagging Marissa for procurement coordination on contract language / evidence delivery timelines.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com
Attachment: IncidentResponse_Playbook_excerpt.pdf; SOC2_summary_2025.pdf
